one_liner: Code hosting and collaboration platform with repos, issues, PRs and CI.

api_note: REST API covers repos, issues, PRs, actions, orgs, etc.; GraphQL also offered (not re-verified on fetched page).
mcp_note: github/github-mcp-server (local Docker, PAT) and a hosted remote server; GitHub-maintained.

one_liner: Web hosting and deployment platform with serverless functions and forms.
auth_note: Personal access token as Bearer for own use; OAuth2 required for public integrations.
access_note: Generate a PAT under User settings > Applications; a Free plan exists (pricing page 'Everything in Free'). Credit-based plans; deploys consume credits.
api_note: Sites, deploys, files, env vars, forms/submissions, hooks, snippets, DNS; OpenAPI reference at open-api.netlify.com. Rate limit 500 req/min, 3 deploys/min.
mcp_note: Official netlify/netlify-mcp; remote at https://mcp.netlify.com/mcp and local @netlify/mcp.

evidence.quote: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication.
Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN>

one_liner: Graph database; Aura cloud has an Aura management API plus Bolt/HTTP query access.
auth_note: Aura API: client ID/secret exchanged for bearer token (client_credentials). Database queries use username/password over Bolt/HTTP.
access_note: Aura API credentials available to all tiers via console Client credentials page. Free Aura instance availability not verified.
api_note: Aura API manages instances (create/delete/snapshots etc.); data access is via Cypher over Bolt/Query API, not a broad resource REST API.
mcp_note: Official neo4j/mcp: local binary, stdio and http, tools for schema, read/write Cypher, GDS.

evidence.quote: All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
curl --request POST 'https://api.neo4j.io/oauth/token' --user '<client_id>:<client_secret>'
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
The official MCP Server for Neo4j, is a local MCP server that is downloadable as a binary
Neo4j MCP implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
